Context: 2. Group Insurance Scheme, 1980

- Para. 8.2.  
- 4. Membership.Employees are enrolled as members of the Scheme only from 1st January every year. If an employee enters service on or after 2nd January in any year, he is enrolled as a member only from 1st January ofthe next year. From the actual date of appointment to 31st December, · he will be entitled only to Insurance Cover. - Paras. 4.3 and 6.
